model: A deterministic policy envelope shared by V13 read surfaces. It standardizes version negotiation, request bounds, abuse controls, cache/freshness behavior and machine-readable error semantics without adding protocol authority.

version.rule: major must match exactly; clients may request a supported minor <= 6

invariants: unsupported API major or future minor versions fail closed
zero-size, oversized, over-filtered and malformed queries fail closed
encoded query size is bounded to 2048 bytes
client request budgets are bounded to 120 requests per 60-second window
rate-limit state rejects local time regression
canonical data uses a short bounded cache policy
finalized data may use a longer immutable-style cache window
freshness checks fail closed when data exceeds the caller's bounded max age
public error codes map to deterministic HTTP status and stable schema-versioned error IDs
API policy grants no execution, custody, mint, burn or settlement authority
